baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction لا تتخذوا ... أولياء couples deliberate acquisition with a relation whose branches include unbroken proximity, governance, and support.
baseline_models.mechanism: The targets are identified by what they do to دينكم: installing such actors as close norm-setters gives purposeless treatment of communal obedience a formative place inside the believing group.

activation_trace.role: Making or acquiring something for oneself supplies the deliberate installation step in the relation.
Obedience and submission make religion an enacted order that can be socially shaped.
Action without a sound intended end supplies the deforming stance toward that enacted order.
Taking charge of an affair gives awliya a norm-setting and governing force beyond casual contact.

changed_reading.before: Do not befriend members of the named communities who mock the religion.
changed_reading.after: Do not deliberately install people who make purposeless sport of your religious obedience into close, governing, or norm-forming roles.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same root frames both commands: believers must not take as awliya those who have taken their religion as mockery and play.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated taking creates a reciprocal danger: their appropriation of religion as an object of amusement can be brought inside the community when believers appropriate them as formative allies.

activation_trace.role: Taking into one's possession links the two opposed acts of taking and makes reciprocal capture visible.
Mockery names the contemptuous use to which the first object, the believers' religion, is put.
Nearness without an intervening gap explains how an external stance can become internally formative.

changed_reading.before: The verse contains a mockery clause and a separate ban on friendship.
changed_reading.after: The ban interrupts a reciprocal chain of appropriation: do not answer their taking of religion as play by taking them into formative proximity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command ends with واتقوا الله إن كنتم مؤمنين, joining protective action to the reality of faith.
baseline_models.mechanism: Taqwa places a barrier against relational harm, while faith is settled trust rather than a label; the allegiance boundary is therefore an enacted test of where security is lodged.

activation_trace.role: A barrier that repels harm supplies the protective function of the command.
Placing oneself in protection turns the closing imperative into deliberate boundary maintenance.
Settled security and trust identify the positive center that the boundary protects.

changed_reading.before: Fear God and avoid a forbidden social relation if you claim belief.
changed_reading.after: Make a protective allegiance boundary as an enactment of settled trust in God, not merely as a social identity marker.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately repeated mockery formula attaches to the audible summons to prayer. Religion-as-play is thus not only an opinion but disruption of a public signal that gathers and orders worship, while failed reason is pictured as failure of restraint.

activation_trace.role: The focus names mockery as the target-defining stance.
Raising the voice makes the object of mockery an audible public summons.
The gathering in an assembly exposes the summons' community-forming function.
The specified act of worship concretizes the otherwise broad دينكم.
Prayer as binding worship supplies the ordered practice being publicly trivialized.
Reason as a restraint from ignorance explains mockery as failed self-binding, not mere humor.

structural_cues: 5:58 repeats اتخذوها هزوا ولعبا from the focus almost verbatim and supplies the concrete object, the call to prayer.
The causal close لا يعقلون follows the repeated formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an audible call, gathered worship, and absent restraint; I infer that formative allies can impair communal coordination by trivializing its public signal. A narrower alternative is that 5:58 only gives one liturgical example.

changed_reading.before: The mockers hold a generally contemptuous attitude toward religion.
changed_reading.after: They convert the community's audible, gathering summons to ordered worship into play, so the allegiance boundary also protects public religious coordination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The entry-exit sequence carries an unchanged concealed commitment across the community's threshold. Unbroken proximity can therefore create a channel through which professed alignment and durable inner orientation diverge.

activation_trace.role: Nearness without a gap supplies the relational threshold whose permeability is at issue.
Movement into an interior supplies the first crossing of the social threshold.
Passage back outside completes a crossing that leaves the carried stance unchanged.
Concealment explains why verbal profession alone cannot reveal the durable orientation moving through the threshold.

structural_cues: 5:61 places قالوا آمنا before دخلوا بالكفر and خرجوا به, then closes with what they conceal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entry, exit, persistence, and concealment; I infer a risk specific to high-trust proximity, where surface profession can mask unchanged formative commitments. The live alternative is that this sequence diagnoses hypocrisy without specifying alliance mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The verse classifies potential allies by overt communal labels.
changed_reading.after: The verse guards high-trust proximity against durable concealed commitments that can cross into and out of the community behind a verbal profession of faith.

context_deltas.mechanism: Failed restraint by religious authorities, recurrent ignition of war, and the later direct reprise of taking disbelievers as awliya form one normative circuit. Wilayah can transmit tolerated conduct and conflict through institutions, not merely express private affection.

activation_trace.role: Standing over an affair supplies the governing and norm-enforcing dimension of the focus relation.
Failure to restrain wrongdoing exposes a breakdown in the governing function expected of learned authorities.
Igniting fire supplies the recurrent initiation stage of the conflict circuit.
War and enmity identify the social output of repeated ignition.
Departure from sound order generalizes the conflict circuit into systemic corruption.
The reciprocal failure to restrain one another shows tolerated conduct propagating through a group.
Actual allegiance to those who disbelieve links private solidarity to the condemned circuit.
The later repeated act of making allies for oneself confirms deliberate relational installation.
The exact awliya reprise returns the sequence to governance and charge over affairs.

structural_cues: 5:63 and 5:79 frame wrongdoing through authorities or peers who do not restrain it.
5:64 uses كلما for repeated war ignition and closes with corruption.
5:80-81 place يتولون and ما اتخذوهم أولياء in immediate succession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed correction, recurrent conflict, systemic corruption, and an exact wilayah reprise; I infer that installed alliances transmit norms and conflict through governing solidarity. Ordinary intimate friendship may remain included, but it does not exhaust the mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Awliya mainly names personally close friends.
changed_reading.after: Awliya includes governing and solidaristic ties that suppress internal correction and connect the community to recurrent conflict-producing networks.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine holding and protection accompanies uncompromised public delivery. The protective command in the focus is therefore not a retreat into fear but a relocation of reliance that permits truthful proclamation without buying safety through hostile patronage.

activation_trace.role: Protective separation names the focus response to harmful formative ties.
Support and alliance identify the human security relation that could be sought as a substitute.
A holding that prevents harm supplies divine protection while the message is delivered openly.

structural_cues: 5:67 joins the uncompromised imperative بلغ with the assurance والله يعصمك من الناس.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies public delivery and divine protection of the messenger; I infer that the focus relocates protective dependence away from compromising patrons. The alternative keeps the assurance specific to the messenger and does not generalize it to every believer.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa and the alliance ban prescribe defensive social withdrawal.
changed_reading.after: They relocate reliance to God so that public religious witness can remain uncompromised rather than being traded for protection from powerful patrons.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later prohibition on following a people's desires gives a directional mechanism for formative allegiance: repeated following lets subjective inclination displace stable truth and draw religious obedience off an extended path.

activation_trace.role: Religion as obedience is the practice whose direction can be socially redirected.
Turning toward, accepting, and following supplies a directional side of formative proximity.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the standard displaced by excess and inclination.
Allegiant succession makes following a repeated relational orientation rather than a single borrowed idea.
The soul's inclination supplies the unstable guide that allegiance can elevate.
Loss of guidance and aim records the cumulative result for leaders and followers.
An extended traversable path turns doctrinal drift into a directional and communal mechanism.

structural_cues: 5:77 addresses excess في دينكم, then prohibits following desires, and repeats ضلوا in a leader-follower sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies excess in religion, desire-following, and repeated path loss; I infer that this specifies how formative allegiance can deform دين. A live alternative treats 5:77 as an admonition to the People of the Book rather than a direct gloss on 5:57.

changed_reading.before: The danger is affection for people who openly mock religion.
changed_reading.after: The deeper danger is granting directional authority to desire-led patterns that make communal obedience follow a lost path, even when presented as religious seriousness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first partitions the People of the Book internally, then positively names closeness and affection toward believers, and finally shows receptive recognition of truth. These contrasts make conduct and response, not inherited category alone, the operative boundary.

activation_trace.role: Love and support are live senses of awliya whose scope the later positive relations force the reader to refine.
Making scripture stand upright supplies a positive behavioral alternative to turning religion into play.
A community as a distinct group enables explicit differentiation within the larger named population.
Moderation between extremes qualifies one internal group positively.
Nearness, the spatial core also present in wilayah, is explicitly evaluated positively here.
Love and affection show that positive intercommunal affect is not itself the forbidden mechanism.
Recognition by a distinguishing sign supplies the receptive opposite of mockery.
Truth stable against falsehood identifies what the receptive group recognizes.

structural_cues: 5:66 contrasts منهم أمة مقتصدة with وكثير منهم inside the same larger population.
5:82 calls one identified group closest in affection to believers.
5:83 answers heard revelation with recognition, tears, faith, and requested inclusion rather than mockery and play.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intragroup partition, positive nearness and affection, and receptive recognition; I infer that the relative clause in 5:57 behaviorally narrows the target and blocks a blanket ban on benign relations. Qurb and wudd are not identical to governing wilayah, so the contrast does not license every alliance.

changed_reading.before: The named communal categories are themselves sufficient grounds for comprehensive social distance.
changed_reading.after: The prohibited relation is behavior-conditioned and formative: the same broad population contains upright and receptive people toward whom closeness and affection can be positive, while governing allegiance to religion-trivializing actors remains barred.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it derives institutional custody from lexical recurrence rather than an explicit office in 5:57. It remains anchored in the focus's double taking, دين as obedience, and awliya as charge over affairs, while 5:70 joins taking to a binding covenant. Render it as an exploratory account of formative authority, not as a replacement gloss for awliya or as a ban on every relation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus opposes two acts of taking around religion and awliya; the later أخذنا ميثاق supplies covenantal custody as a third act of taking.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate acquisition connects the two focus acts and permits an exploratory custody reading.
Obedience gives the object of custody an enacted communal form.
Charge over an affair supplies the institutional role into which an actor may be installed.
God's taking of the covenant activates possession as solemn custody rather than casual association.
The confirmed covenant supplies the binding object whose mediation can be entrusted or betrayed.

changed_reading.before: The verse regulates friendship with religious mockers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it regulates custody of covenant-shaped communal obedience: do not install its trivializers as the people charged with mediating and guarding it.

strongest_changes: The immediate prayer-call reprise turns generic mockery into disruption of an audible, gathering public practice.
The later failure of restraint and exact 5:80-81 wilayah reprise make normative governance and conflict transmission central senses of the prohibited relation.
The internal distinctions of 5:66 and the positive closeness, affection, and recognition of 5:82-83 block a blanket category-based social reading.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly reuses the focus's roots and constructions but then places condemned wilayah beside positive qurb and wudd. That sequence preserves a firm allegiance boundary while sharply distinguishing formative authority from ordinary or receptive intercommunal closeness.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact boundary among intimate friendship, political alliance, patronage, and governing authority remains polysemous in awliya.
The divine-protection inference may be specific to the messenger rather than a general rule for all believers.
The covenant-custody model is traceable but remains an exploratory institutional extension of the repeated taking motif.
